method: Wednesday spread-based upset screen plus exact-price governance

coverage.price_policy: Exact moneylines never inferred from spreads.

criteria.name: structural-resistance
criteria.evidence: Frozen structural lean TB; structural fair Dallas Cowboys -1.2.

criteria.name: prior-quality-gap
criteria.evidence: Preseason prior -0.16 vs opponent -1.96.

criteria.name: recent-form
criteria.evidence: Prior-week scoring margin -3.

criteria.name: availability
criteria.evidence: Final injury/inactive status is not assumed on Wednesday morning; late availability is an execution veto.

candidates.analysis: Upset/underdog research completed from spread, frozen model and prior-week state. Exact moneyline is not inferred; price qualification waits for a directly observed governed ML.
